info.text:
10 missed days cut a 20-year investment by over half.
J.P. Morgan's hypothetical: $10,000 in the S&P 500 (2006-2025) grew to $80,619 fully invested. Missing the 10 best days left $35,866, about 56% less.
Why it matters now: on Monday (Nov 23), the S&P 500 jumped 4.73% to 7,237.17, its best day since April 2025, right after seven straight losing days.
J.P. Morgan: six of the 10 best days from 2006 to 2025 occurred within two weeks of the 10 worst days.
Sources: AP, CNBC, J.P. Morgan Asset Management Guide to Retirement 2026.
News and education, not financial advice.
